## ip_locations: Where the IP addresses in the records are registered
IP address 192.0.2.33 — according to Example IP Database, 2025-10-01: registered to Example Cloud Hosting (AS64504), location Example Port, Exampleland (accuracy about 200 km). (E4)

An IP location is the provider's estimate of where the network is registered or used. It can differ from where the person was, for example on mobile data, a VPN or a hosting service. Addresses can be reassigned over time; this lookup used a database dated 2025-10-01.
